immigration.text: Torres cosponsored the American Dream and Promise Act and defended DACA recipients, calling for permanent protections and a pathway to citizenship.
immigration.quote: Today's Supreme Court ruling sends a clear message that DACA recipients are Americans in every way

guns.text: Torres, a former 911 dispatcher, repeatedly calls for stronger gun laws to keep firearms from dangerous people.
guns.quote: At a bare minimum, we owe it to them to pass the common-sense laws that would prevent the same events from playing out, over and over.

abortion.text: Torres, Vice Chair of the Pro-Choice Caucus, co-sponsors legislation to guarantee abortion access and defends reproductive rights.
abortion.quote: Every woman should have the ability to make her own personal medical decisions and access reproductive health care.

health.text: Voted against the One Big Beautiful Bill Act after the scorecard identified it as cutting Medicaid funding and disqualifying Planned Parenthood from the program.
health.quote: A bill to drastically cut Medicaid funding and disqualify Planned Parenthood from participating in the program for one year.

voting.text: Torres voted for the For the People Act to expand voting access and counter new voting restrictions.
voting.quote: There is nothing more important to the health of our democracy than access to the polls

tax.text: Cargile says taxes should be reduced and government regulation cut to support economic growth.
tax.quote: Lower the tax burden and eliminate government over-regulation and we will bounce back quicker than it takes to pack up and move to Texas!

wages.text: Cargile rejects a government responsibility to guarantee everyone a livable income and emphasizes free enterprise.
wages.quote: It is the government’s responsibility to ensure everyone has a livable income. Strongly Disagree

debt.text: Cargile says he would vote to protect Social Security benefits for future generations.
debt.quote: Get elected to Congress and vote to protect it. There really is no other safeguard.

schools.text: Cargile supports allowing parents to choose among public, private, charter, online and home schools.
schools.quote: Parents should be able to choose the school and environment best suited for their child.

safety.text: Cargile says he supports law enforcement and first responders and favors enforcement responses to crime and border violations.
safety.quote: Mike stands WITH our Law Enforcement and First Responders.

immigration.text: Cargile supports completing a border wall and deporting people who remain in the country illegally after refusing to leave.
immigration.quote: Those who refuse to self-deport will be deported forcibly and without prejudice.

guns.text: Cargile says gun ownership is an unrestricted constitutional right and opposes broad government oversight.
guns.quote: This unrestricted right is recognized as belonging to the common citizens (Militia) of the United States

abortion.text: Cargile says he would not support abortion except in cases of rape, incest or danger to the mother’s life.
abortion.quote: Therefore, except in the case of rape, incest or the life of the mother, I will never support abortion.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Cargile opposes boys participating in girls’ sports and men using women’s bathrooms.
gender.quote: Mike wholeheartedly stands against boys in girls’ sports, men in women’s bathrooms

cannabis.quote: I support the legalization of recreational marijuana. Strongly Disagree

health.text: Cargile opposes government responsibility for guaranteeing health insurance and favors competition in the private marketplace.
health.quote: Allow robust competition in the marketplace and remove governmental restraints.

energy.text: Cargile supports oil and gas production and opposes policies he says would move the country away from fossil fuels.
energy.quote: The lifeblood of the American economy is crude oil.

voting.text: Cargile lists requiring photo identification for national elections as a legislative priority.
voting.quote: Photo ID Required to vote in a National Election
